description: Construction rules of the real-data truth panel, as implemented in build_truths.py and checked independently by check_integrity.py.

rules.rule: 2024-04-01 through 2024-05-15 inclusive, one truth per calendar day with positive in-universe mass
Read tpep_pickup_datetime and PULocationID only. Coerce timestamps. Drop rows with a null timestamp or zone. Cast zone to int. Keep rows whose date falls in the file month.
Sorted unique integer PULocationID values from the filtered training months (261 zones).
float64 vector of universe length holding the day's pickup counts per zone; zones absent that day are zero.
Each non-empty JSON line with a truthy repo.name increments that repository by 1. Blank lines and JSON errors are skipped. No event-type filter.
Counter.most_common(2000) over the summed training-hour counts in train-day order; ties keep first-seen order. All 14 training objects are required.
Uncompressed float64 .npy; both the file and the raw array bytes are hashed in the manifests.
SHA-256 of utf-8 MASTER|truth_id|mech|eps|k|wf|rep with MASTER=20260807; first 16 hex digits as int, modulo 2**31-1.
